integrity_statement: The unrestricted theorem follows from a symbolic closed form and Dirichlet theorem; finite exact-arithmetic verification is supplemental and is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only sequences with repeated nonzero integer root and nonvanishing positive-index terms; does not treat distinct-root, irrational-root or zero-term recurrences. The proof invokes Dirichlet primes in arithmetic progressions. The first prime witness is not uniformly bounded; unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Sharp binomid classification for integer repeated-root recurrences
